title: Treadsetter
description:
Give someone a shoe...
Teach someone to make shoes...
...Or, recognize and celebrate an innovative method of shoe-making that has been there all along?

Visit our *Etsy Shop* to find a style of authentic, hand-crafted tire-tread footwear for you! https://www.etsy.com/shop/AtingaProject

An analogy for much more than shoes, questioning even the well-known adage "Give a man a fish, teach a man to fish..." this video preceded our Kickstarter campaign in 2014. 

Introducing The Atinga Project: the recycled-tire footwear social enterprise that beckons all to "walk a mile in their shoes" and tread for change.
